data.name: Major Aspect of the Stag
data.description: Your shape changes to that of a Large stag (Bestiary 4 p150), but its space changes to 10 feet. While in this form, you gain a gore attack (1d6 damage), two hoof attacks (1d4 damage), a base speed of 50 feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet).

raw_tokens.value: Your shape changes to that of a Large stag (Bestiary 4 p150), but its space changes to 10 feet. While in this form, you gain a gore attack (1d6 damage), two hoof attacks (1d4 damage), a base speed of 50 feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet).
You gain a +4 racial bonus on Acrobatic checks when jumping.|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterStagAspectLVL,8

You gain the Awesome Blow and Improved Natural Attack feats (Bestiary p314, p315) for gore attacks, and you can use Awesome Blow against a creature of your size or smaller.|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterStagAspectLVL,15
